faqs.a:
In the event of the removal of any commissioner, the mayor shall appoint, with the
               approval of city council, a resident of the city to hold the position of commissioner
               during the unexpired term of the commissioner; thereafter, at the next regular election
               of city council, the appointed commissioner shall be replaced by the elected councilperson.
(Code 1981, § 14-12; Ord. No. 1248, § 6(5), 6-16-1975)
